steps.what: List the ensemble call already posted for the scene.
Collaborate with the other actors as an ensemble.
Keep the shared timing the ensemble found in the room.

tasks.design: An ensemble call already posted for the scene is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor collaborates with the other actors and keeps the timing they find together. A call with no scene id is not listed. The list does not play the scene.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ensemble calls were a group message, and someone always had the wrong scene.
tasks.enabler_now: A posted ensemble call can be listed before the actors meet.
tasks.still_hard: The timing between actors, which exists only when they play together.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can adjust to another actor in the moment the call cannot describe.
tasks.altitude: A posted ensemble call can be listed. The actor still collaborates and still keeps the shared timing.

reach.task: Meet at the posted time, and still find the ensemble timing in the room.
reach.learn: The call can be listed. The ensemble stays here.

evidence.claim: An ensemble call already posted can be listed. The list cannot collaborate or keep time with other actors.
The ensemble is the actors together. A call does not replace a performer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Call id and scene id, produced by the posted call. A call with no scene id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the call the company already posts.
unknowns: Which ensemble calls are already posted.
Which scenes depend on another actor being present.
research_questions: What share of ensemble work starts from a posted call?
Which scenes are retimed in the room?

already_counted.description: The actor still collaborates in the ensemble.
The actor still keeps the shared timing.

incremental.description: The actor confirms an ensemble call the list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing an ensemble call already posted. It disappears when the call is missing and the actor confirms it. Collaborating with the other actors stays in the room.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List characters already marked in the script.
Learn about characters in scripts and their relationships to each other.
Develop role interpretations from that reading.

tasks.design: Characters already marked in the script are listed from {DOCS}. The actor learns the characters and their relationships and develops the interpretation. A character with no id is not listed. The list does not develop the role.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actor searched the full script for every time a character was named.
tasks.enabler_now: A character already marked can be listed before the actor reads the relationships.
tasks.still_hard: What the relationship means in this production, which the mark does not say.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can read every marked entrance and still find a different relationship.
tasks.altitude: Marked characters can be listed. The actor still learns them and still develops the interpretation.

reach.task: Mark a character in the script, and leave what it means with the actor.
reach.learn: The mark can be listed. The interpretation stays here.

evidence.claim: A character already marked in the script can be listed. The list cannot learn the relationship or develop the interpretation.
The actor develops the reading. A mark in a script is not an interpretation and it is not a performance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.

Fields: Character id, produced by marks already in the script the production holds. An unmarked character is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the script the company is already allowed to study.
unknowns: Which relationships are only clear in rehearsal.
research_questions: What share of character work starts from a marked name?
Which relationships are not marked in the script?

already_counted.description: The actor still learns the characters.
The actor still develops the interpretation.

incremental.description: The actor marks a character the script list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing characters already marked in the script. It disappears when the character is unmarked and the actor finds the name. Learning the relationships and developing the interpretation stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the scene already set for this emotional beat.
Perform humorous and serious interpretations using facial expressions and gestures.
Perform the emotions, actions, and situations with body movements.

tasks.design: A scene already set for the beat is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor performs the humorous or serious interpretation, with facial expression, gesture, and body movement. A scene with no id is not listed. The list does not perform the emotion.
tasks.previous_blocker: The beat was named in a note the actor saw as they walked on.
tasks.enabler_now: A scene already set can be listed before the actor performs the beat.
tasks.still_hard: The emotion, which is performed and not listed.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can play a situation the note calls serious as the room needs it.
tasks.altitude: A set scene can be listed. The actor still performs the emotion, the action, and the situation.

reach.task: Have the scene set, and leave the performed emotion with the actor.
reach.learn: The scene can be listed. The performance stays here.

evidence.claim: A scene already set can be listed. The list cannot perform an emotion, a gesture, or a facial expression.
The performance is the actor's body. A scene list is not a portrayal.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Scene id, produced by the call already set. A scene with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the call the company already keeps. The actor performs.
unknowns: Which beats are already set on a scene.
Which emotions are found only in performance.
research_questions: What share of beats are already set on a scene?
Which interpretations change in front of the audience?

already_counted.description: The actor still performs the interpretation.
The actor still performs the emotion and the action.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a beat the call did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a scene already set for the beat. It disappears when the scene is missing and the actor confirms it. Performing the emotion, the action, and the situation stays with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Mark the passage already chosen in the script or book.
Read from scripts or books to narrate the action.
Inform or entertain audiences, utilizing few or no stage props.

tasks.design: A passage already chosen in the script or the book is marked in {DOCS}. The actor reads it to narrate the action and to inform or entertain the audience, with few or no stage props. A passage with no id is not marked. The mark does not narrate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actor hunted the passage in the book in the minutes before the reading.
tasks.enabler_now: A passage already chosen can be marked before the actor reads.
tasks.still_hard: The narration, which is the voice and not the mark.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can read a marked passage and still make the audience hear it.
tasks.altitude: A chosen passage can be marked. The actor still narrates it.

reach.task: Have the passage marked, and leave the narration with the actor.
reach.learn: The mark can be shared. The reading stays here.

evidence.claim: A passage already chosen in a script or a book can be marked. The mark cannot narrate the action.
The actor reads. A mark is not a narration and it does not replace the performer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.

Fields: Passage id, produced by a choice already made in the script the production holds. A passage with no id is not marked. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the script or book the company is already allowed to read aloud.
research_questions: What share of narrations start from a marked passage?
Which readings are from an unmarked book?

already_counted.description: The actor still narrates the action.
The actor still reads to the audience.

incremental.description: The actor finds a passage the mark did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is marking a passage already chosen in the script or the book. It disappears when the passage is not chosen and the actor finds it. Narrating the action stays with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The actor still plays in the ensemble, still learns the character, still performs the emotion, and still narrates. A marked character or a marked passage can be listed. The performance stays in the body.
reach: Musicians and singers keep ensemble timing in the room, and this job learns a listed call is not that timing.
Audio and video technicians can have the passage marked, and this job learns the narration is still spoken.
skills_to_grow: Play the ensemble in the room.
Narrate the passage. A mark in the script is not the reading.
role.ambitious_version: Marked characters and marked passages are listed first. Ensemble, character work, emotion, and narration stay with the actor.
